title: Beyond the Classroom

shots.image: an open laptop beside neat teaching materials in morning light, close view
shots.sfx: laptop chime, morning birds, no music

shots.image: {TRAINER} at a beautiful home workspace with plants, bookshelves and a window onto a green garden, side view
shots.motion: she adjusts her glasses and starts typing
shots.sfx: keyboard typing, birds outside, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The classroom was no longer the only place where I could teach.

shots.image: {TRAINER} leading an online workshop, her laptop showing a grid of small video windows of educators, seen over her shoulder
shots.sfx: online meeting chime, keyboard, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I began conducting online training workshops for people in the education field.

shots.image: {TRAINER} preparing colourful presentation slides and notes at her desk, side view
shots.motion: she arranges slides and writes notes
shots.sfx: mouse clicks, pen writing, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was sharing ideas, explaining strategies and helping other educators grow.

shots.image: a laptop screen showing a teacher on a video call raising his hand, {TRAINER} watching, seen over her shoulder

lines.speaker: PARTICIPANT
lines.text: Could you show us a practical example?

shots.image: {TRAINER} smiling and pointing to a whiteboard behind her during the video call, side view

lines.speaker: WOMAN
lines.text: Absolutely. Let's work through it together.

shots.image: the laptop screen showing educators nodding happily in their video windows
{TRAINER} at the window at dawn holding a cup of tea, birds flying over green trees, seen from behind
shots.sfx: dawn birds, gentle breeze, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Technology opened new doors for me.

shots.image: {TRAINER} in front of a large screen showing many educators from different cities in small windows, seen from behind
shots.motion: more windows light up one by one
shots.sfx: soft notification sounds, keyboard, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I realised that teaching could reach people far beyond one classroom.

shots.image: {TRAINER} working on curriculum documents, assessment sheets and digital learning materials spread across her desk, close side view

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: My journey was becoming bigger, and I was ready to learn even more.
